buddskees, one more thing before you log off: If you're gonna make a mistake, make it at full speed and learn it at half.

Don't be hard on yourself; be honest with yourself. - Coach Lasso

- Goal involvements 0, down from your usual 4. It happens. It can't keep happening.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. From the clipboard: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.

Hey, PhogsToffees. Fall seven times, stand up eight, then ask for the ball.

The best is ahead of you. - Coach Lasso
